summary: You're pulled between your own direction and the people you love.
body: You're pulled between your own direction and the people you love. Choose yourself, the guilt creeps in. Choose them, the resentment builds. Your Sun opposite Moon isn't asking you to pick a side, it's asking you to stop believing you have to. Closeness doesn't require losing yourself. Independence doesn't require distance. Hold both.
gift: Relational awareness, self-awareness, and the ability to understand two opposing needs without collapsing either one.
shadow: Guilt when choosing yourself, resentment when choosing others, and the belief that closeness and independence cannot both exist.
integration: Build a life where connection and self-direction can both have room.
do: Notice when you think you have to pick a side
Make space for closeness and independence
Name guilt and resentment before they choose for you
dont: Use distance as the only way to protect yourself
Let relationships decide who you are
